description.narrative:
This proposal aims to support the Municipality of Congonhas, located in the state of Minas Gerais, Brazil, in the revision of its 2006 Master Plan and in the development of the city's Mobility Plan. The goal is to rethink the tools and management strategies and ensure a fair and sustainable development for Congonhas. In this sense, this proposal for the revision of Congonhas' Master Plan and the development of the Mobility Plan should be addressed from multiple interdisciplinary fronts and between secretariats, including:
Diagnosis: promote a critical evaluation of the local regulatory framework to recognize the advances and successful experiences carried out by the municipality and at the same time identify the problems and obstacles to be overcome;
Capacity building: promote a level of training for the various actors involved in relation to the SDGs, New Urban Agenda, Paris Agreement, Aichi Targets, Sendai Framework, national urban policies, as well as their federal programs concerning urbanism, environment, and synergistic areas to build a referential framework to guide the work;
Participation and dialogue: adopt a participatory process , attentive to local culture, constituted spaces, and organized movements, understanding that collecting effective contributions from engaged actors is essential for the success of their implementation. The presence and permanent monitoring of civil society, the private sector, and academia in all phases of the elaboration of the plans is a condition for them to acquire the status of a pact for development, capable of producing effects that transcend the electoral calendar and provide stability to municipal public policies;
Plan development: revise the current Master Plan to make it applicable and capable of immediate implementation, centered on the articulation, in the territory, of the various sectoral policies, proposing innovative alternatives in the areas of basic services, mobility, public space, spatial connectivity and productivity, resource efficiency, urban resilience, urban security, solid waste management, clean energy, and "Housing in the Center" of urban planning and development;
Monitoring and evaluation: implement a continuous monitoring and evaluation system of the project and the population, to verify if the objectives are being achieved and if there is a need for adjustments or course corrections.
To achieve this, UN-Habitat and the Municipality of Congonhaswill work in the following:
Objective - Inclusive Master Plan and Mobility Plan guided by the Sustainable Development Goals improve the quality of life of the population of Congonhas.
Outcome 1 - Municipal government of Congonhas with a revised Master Plan guided by the New Urban Agenda and aligned with 2030 Agenda.
1.1 Consolidated Work Plan elaborated 1.2 Diagnosis of the current regulatory framework developed 1.3 Characterization of the municipality carried out 1.4 Training of representatives from the public sector and the Master Plan and Mobility Plan Councils conducted 1.5 Master Plan developed
Outcome 2 - Municipality of Congonhas with a Mobility Plan guided by the New Urban Agenda and aligned with the 2030 Agenda
2.1 Characterization of the mobility system in Congonhas carried on 2.2 Participatory diagnosis on the mobility of the city of Congonhas elaborated 2.3 Mobility Plan developed
Outcome 3 - Adoption of a participatory process for the revision of the Master Plan and the elaboration of the Mobility Plan in Congonhas.
3.1 Communication and awareness plan implemented 3.2 Consultations with the community to discuss and validate proposals for the Master Plan conducted 3.3 Virtual workshops to discuss and validate proposals for the Mobility Plan conducted 3.4 Report with the systematization of the project process and lessons learned elaborated
The project will apply a gender lens by promoting a participatory process that place women and girls in the center of urban planning and design, taking as a principle that they plan and design with diversity and needs in mind different of that from the actors that usually lead and are heard
Based on this participatory approach, the project team and Congonhas government will maintain close coordination with key partners as a key aspect of the project. The participatory approach will allow the project to benefit from various opinions of different stakeholders to shape the Plans.
